text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay focused until the afternoon. Around five, I go for a run or visit the gym because exercise helps me relax and stay healthy. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a series with my family. I try to go to bed before eleven. Keeping the same schedule every day gives me energy and helps me feel calm and productive.
